title: Document Q&A assistant

invariants.claim: A chunk longer than 448 model tokens fails ingest instead of storing a truncated vector.
A claim without an in-context citation, or whose quote is not a normalised substring of the cited chunk, is dropped.
Ingest refuses a PDF whose SHA-256 differs from corpus.lock.json.
The refusal threshold comes from eval/calibration.json at boot and is never hand-tuned.
Every rate carries a Wilson 95% interval and its denominator; the earliest failed stage is recorded per question.
The judge model differs from the generator and is pinned by exact id.
ONNX work runs in a worker thread behind Semaphore(2).

limits: The eval set is 30 questions (24 answerable, 6 unanswerable), not the planned 100; intervals are wide.
Citation precision and faithfulness are rule-based, rest on n=9, and reach down to 45.3%.
The calibration is fitted in-sample on the same 30 gold questions the eval runs.
There is no hosted URL, k6 is not installed, and the free endpoint has no SLA.
